parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: Resource type: pipeline (pipeline) or hostGroup (host group)

parameters.name: roleName
parameters.description:
Role

For deployment group (hostGroup):
- user: member with usage permission  
- admin: administrator with edit permission  
- owner: owner with all permissions  

For pipeline:
- owner: owner with all permissions  
- admin: View, Run, and Edit permissions  
- member: Run permission  
- viewer: View permission
